title: VisibilitySessionCreateRequest
description: Create or resume a user-scoped visibility session for the supplied resume key and topology binding.

resumeKey.description: Server-stable contextual resume key for the current user and workbench binding.

base.description: Validated topology base/binding the session should remain pinned to.

selection.description: Optional current topology selection when the session is first created.

chatThreadId.description: Optional existing contextual chat thread to associate with the session.
